title: Handle daemon recovery dispatch loss and reconnect without replay
outcome: Handle daemon recovery dispatch loss and reconnect without replay
acceptance: real EOF, malformed result, and actual transport loss return typed unknown outcome/no replay; next call reconnects; protocol rejection stays protocol rejection.

completion.summary: Unreadable null/malformed dispatched results now return typed unknown outcome without replay, invalidate client and allow next-call reconnect. Graceful FIN/EOF plus next reconnect already passed PRE-fix; no claim that EOF itself was broken. Per-row control preserves protocol tool error and handles initialize rejection. Both original reviewers verified source and parent artifacts; original Low next-call coverage satisfied here. Parent RED proves untyped results, not that every malformed-response peer would be permanently dead.
